messages:
Liam Carter: heads up — AWS marketplace PO approvals are failing for account ACME-123. The payload from marketplace contains `billing_entity` while our deal desk expects `bill_to_entity_id`. Getting 400s from PO webhook. Example snippet:
```
{"po_id": "PO-9981","billing_entity": "acme-corp"}
```
Anyone seen this mapping mismatch before? @Anya_Patel @Sara_Gomez

Anya Patel: I saw something similar with the Azure feed last week. Legal shipped a schema tweak but partner didn't bump the `X-Marketplace-Schema` header. :thinking_face: Can you paste the webhook headers or the trace id?

Liam Carter: headers show `X-Marketplace-Schema: v1` but body keys look like v1.1. Trace id from ingestion: `trc-55b3`. Also seeing `400` body: `unknown field bill_to_entity_id`.

Kevin Wu: Ops POV — we can add tolerant parsing in the PO ingestion service to accept `billing_entity` as an alias for `bill_to_entity_id`. Minimal change: accept both keys and map to internal `bill_to_entity_id`. Quick PR, canary first. Will need finance signoff for mapping to vendor_code.

Sara Gomez: mapping matters for GL. We need a clear mapping doc showing `billing_entity` -> vendor_code resolution rules. Also want a test PO showing full payload before we allow automated mapping. Can't change month-end flows without clear audit trail.

Anya Patel: I'll open a ticket with AWS partner ops asking for stable schema header and explicit field mapping. Recommend implementing tolerant parsing as a short-term patch. Action items: @Kevin_Wu draft patch, @Liam_Carter collect failed PO samples and headers, @Sara_Gomez confirm GL mapping and test cases.

finance-bot: Reminder: any PO ingestion change that affects vendor mapping requires PM signoff and may impact month-end reconciliation if released after day 20 of the month.

Liam Carter: noted. I'll gather 5 failed POs + headers and upload to the partnership drive (link coming). ETA EOD today. If Kevin can cut a PR by tomorrow we can run canary next week.

Anya Patel: thanks all — will loop in @marketplace-partner-ops once I have the ticket. :thumbsup:
